Guarda Wallet is a non-custodial multi-currency wallet that supports many blockchains. Guarda Wallet gives users control of their own private keys. Guarda Wallet is available as a browser extension, desktop application and mobile application.

Parity wallet is a multi-signature wallet built on the Ethereum blockchain. Parity wallet relies on smart contracts whose transactions require multiple approvals. Parity wallet suffered a 2017 vulnerability that led to the loss of funds. Parity wallet users were also affected by a later incident in which a shared library contract was made unusable, freezing funds.

Poly Network is a cross-chain interoperability protocol that connects different blockchains. Poly Network operates through smart contracts on public blockchains. Poly Network was the target of a large hack in August 2021, and most of the stolen funds were later returned.

Eleven Finance is a yield aggregation protocol in the decentralized finance ecosystem. Eleven Finance automates yield farming strategies through smart contracts.

Crypto.com Onchain is a non-custodial Web3 wallet that gives users access to decentralized finance applications. Crypto.com Onchain keeps control of private keys with the user rather than with an intermediary.
